notes.title: MiceGard - Release
notes.notes:
Play MiceGard, an adventure game where Viking mice fight for honor, glory and survival. Explore a world inspired by Norse mythology, meet gods and sorcerers, and become the fiercest mousy warrior in this action-packed saga.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2430660/MiceGard/

notes.title: Update 1.1 is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello! We have prepared a new update based on your feedback. Thanks for sharing your thoughts on the game!

- A new monster that will be present in all locations
- New perk "Reflection of projectiles"
- New type of Arena.
- Improved AI of some enemies
- Fixed a lot of bugs, including endless arena bugs and death during the final dialogue
- Fix English translation

The most important part of the update is the new arenas.
Previously, there were 2 levels and a boss during the race. Now between the two levels there will be a large arena where you need to confront a large number of enemies.

Thank you for the feedback!
